summary: Round 2 closes ORG-001 through ORG-004 with nothing blocking left. ORG-001 is closed: proposal lines 183-201 require central pytest collection exclusions for notes/archives/**, scripts/pr187_pr208/** and scripts/pr299_perlmutter/** plus any other frozen directory found in the import ledger. The hook or configuration must sit outside the snapshots, with no edits or __init__ files added inside them. Lint and pre-commit rewriting hooks get matching exclusions, and hash integrity checks still cover every excluded file. The archive checks are named offline commands, and step 5 requires an explicit list of maintained tests and a broad-collection check that picks up no frozen files. ORG-002 is closed: lines 117-120 state the root used for each column and line 134 names repository-root validation/input-bookkeeping-20261110/. ORG-003 is closed: lines 99-107 make the stable ID the canonical key, catalog and manifest must agree on record_path and script_roots, and the validator checks this. ORG-004 is closed: lines 288-296 declare campaigns/**, templates/**, catalog/FORMAT, frozen scripts, campaign orchestration and archives source-only, and step 5 checks them in Meson and wheel output. This round I read the source excerpts for PR187/208, PR299 and the old catalog myself. They support the proposal's claims: the PR299 verifier requires exact repository-relative coverage under rglob, so no files may be added to its directories; PR187 has a 47-file manifest and a test_startup.py command; check_catalog.py works out its roots from fixed directory depths and hardcodes inherited root notes/sim10_striping_20261110; the 156/54 case counts appear in the code; and the README/IMPORTS evidence covers the reference/latest copies and the missing SDF inputs. No regressions found: the standard docs/examples conventions, the no-wholesale-merge rule, the separation of statistical/cache/NIC/GDS limitations from staging/application correctness, keeping thresholds out of pytest, and the achievable migration steps are all still in place. One low-severity, non-blocking issue about labels in the review records is reported as ORG-005.

The proposal's repository-root form of the unittest command is equivalent.

Repository-relative SCRIPTS/EVIDENCE/REPORT constants and rglob-based exact checksum coverage confirm that the package must stay at its paths, that nothing may be added inside it (conftest, __init__, __pycache__), and that the proposal correctly forbids initializers in snapshot trees. Also confirmed: C1 unfixed, Run77 deferred, uncontrolled cache, CPU controls not equal-work, and the trailing-whitespace/end-of-file hook caveat.

Inspected the old README, FORMAT.md, lines 1-125 of check_catalog.py, sources/README.md and the start of IMPORTS.json. Confirmed fixed-depth ROOT/REPO inference and the exact 5-part path check, the inherited REPO/notes/sim10_striping_20261110 dependency (beyond the 359 added files), 156 SDF and 54 C++ case counts, reference/latest snapshots, 8 missing SDF inputs, and receipt paths embedded under benchmarks/scaling/sources/. The proposal's relocation ledger and byte-preservation rule fit these.

Checked psana/meson.build:310-330: install_subdir('psana') excludes only 'gpu/notes' among GPU paths, so docs/ and scripts/ are installed by default. The ORG-004 source-only classification and the Meson/wheel checks are needed and sufficient as design requirements.

Checked pyproject.toml: [tool.ruff] has no exclude and there is no pytest configuration. No repository conftest.py, pytest.ini, setup.cfg or tox.ini was found, so the ORG-001 central-configuration requirement is new work and achievable.

Checked .pre-commit-config.yaml: the rewriting hooks are trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer and mixed-line-ending. All of them fall under the proposal's general 'pre-commit rewriting hooks need matching path exclusions' rule.

Compared the hashes in the supplied exact verification with validation-02.json: the proposal and source-inventory SHA256 values are identical, which ties the supplied 596f137 verification to this proposal revision.
limitations: I ran no commands. I did not recompute any SHA256, including the excerpt and evidence hashes or the proposal hash. I relied on the coordinator's supplied exact-commit verification for hash matches and for the claim that only the proposal and records changed.

Source excerpts are partial: the first 85 of verify_archive.py's lines, the first 125 of check_catalog.py's, the first 19 of manifest.json's and the first 28 of IMPORTS.json's. replay_sdf_report.py, catalog.json, review/FINAL.md, hardware.md, history.md, pr187_pr208.md and packaging-summary.json are listed in sources.json but are not excerpted, so I did not inspect them. Per scope, external inspection_copy paths were not read.
The full dependency closure and the completeness of the 359-file ledger are future migration requirements and cannot be confirmed at design time.
No runtime, GPU or performance tests are expected for this design-only deliverable, and none were assumed.

findings.evidence: CLOSED. Lines 183-192 require pytest recursive-collection exclusions for notes/archives/**, scripts/pr187_pr208/**, scripts/pr299_perlmutter/** and every other frozen directory in the import ledger. The configuration or hook must live outside those directories, with no historical test edits or added package initializers (consistent with verify_archive.py's rglob exact-coverage rule). Ruff, formatter and pre-commit rewriting exclusions are required, and integrity hashes still cover excluded files. Lines 194-201 name the standalone PR299 and PR187 offline commands and forbid collecting every test_*.py. Step 5 (lines 317-321) requires an explicit maintained-test list and a broad-collection check showing that no frozen files are collected.

CLOSED. Line 45 limits the GPU-relative convention to the tree. Lines 117-120 say source paths are repository-root unless prefixed GPU: and destinations are GPU-relative unless marked repository-root. Line 134 names repository-root validation/input-bookkeeping-20261110/ explicitly.

CLOSED. Lines 99-107 make the stable campaign ID the canonical key. catalog.json maps it to repository-root-relative record_path and script_roots, and manifest.json repeats both. New scripts go in scripts/campaigns/<id>/ with safe single-component IDs, and there are explicit exceptions for historical multi-root and synthesis records. The validator checks uniqueness, agreement, existence/containment and the new-directory ID, and does not infer pairings from dates.

CLOSED. Lines 288-296 classify docs/performance/campaigns/**, docs/performance/templates/**, catalog/FORMAT, frozen script packages, scripts/campaigns and GPU notes archives as source-only. They keep curated current reports, design/API pages and examples installed, and require published links from any installed index. These paths are added to the Meson/wheel checks, and step 5 (lines 321-323) verifies them. meson.build:329 confirms that only gpu/notes is excluded today.
